archetype: The Executive Command Center (Performance Pro x Swiss Precision)

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace
typography.heading_rules: Use tracking-tight for H1-H3. Never use generic Inter or Arial for main headings.

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_structure: MODE B High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4

score_cards.style: High-impact stat tiles with subtle gradient glows, circular/bar indicators, and dynamic diff comparison tags (+5%, Competitive Lead, Threat).

ai_executive_summary.style: Glow border card with AI badge, quick takeaways bullet points, key strategic risks, and dynamic refresh trigger.

feature_comparison_matrix.style: Dense tabular grid with custom visual status icons (Check green = Available, Cross red = Not Available, Question amber = Unknown/Unclear), hover row highlight, and category filter chips.

scatter_chart.style: Interactive positioning chart using Recharts ScatterPlot or custom SVG canvas with customizable X (e.g. Price) and Y (e.g. Feature Score) axes, quadrant labels (Market Leaders, Niche Players, Budget Alternatives, Premium Overpriced), and interactive tooltips.

radar_chart.style: Multi-dimensional company comparison overlay (Overall, Features, Pricing, AI, UX, Support).

swot_quadrants.style: 4-card matrix grid (Strengths = Green tint, Weaknesses = Amber tint, Opportunities = Blue tint, Threats = Rose tint) with actionable bullet tags.

recommended_actions.style: Priority-ordered list with P0 (Red badge), P1 (Orange badge), P2 (Blue badge) tags and interactive status dropdowns (Not Started / In Progress / Completed).

onboarding_guide.style: Step-by-step interactive banner/modal guiding the user through: 1. Add Competitor -> 2. AI Scraping -> 3. View Intelligence Dashboard -> 4. Export PDF.

avatars.description: Executive portrait - Male CEO / Product Lead

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, tabs, chart container, table rows, badges, and modals MUST include data-testid attributes.
testing_and_accessibility.convention: kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='add-competitor-button', data-testid='competitor-row-acme-inc', data-testid='pdf-export-button', data-testid='login-submit-button'.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA / APCA compliant. All text must maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast against surface background.
testing_and_accessibility.hover_rule: Every hover state MUST explicitly define text color alongside background color change.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js) files for all React component development.
Build a complete, responsive left navigation bar with items: Dashboard, Competitors, Compare, Insights, SWOT, Settings.
Ensure all data sources show confidence scores (e.g. 94% Confidence), last crawled date, and source URL fallback.
Implement PDF Export using html2canvas/jspdf or window.print with custom @media print stylesheet.
Provide seed competitor data (e.g., Acme Intelligence, SaaS Pulse, OmniMetrics) with option to add real/mock scraped competitors.
Add toast notifications using Sonner for user actions (e.g., 'Competitor added', 'Scraping initiated', 'PDF exported').
Include guided onboarding banner with step indicators that can be dismissed or restarted.
